zero_budget_policy.browser_pwa: primary public playable path while no genuinely zero-cost native GPU route exists
zero_budget_policy.unreal: development/AAA target; local or genuinely zero-cost execution only unless owner later changes the zero-spend rule
zero_budget_policy.free_sources_only: original, public-domain, CC0, or otherwise explicitly verified for the intended commercial use

world.regional_goal: recognizable real-world exterior geography and regional feel, transformed into an original zombified/horrorified survival world
world.exterior_truth: source-backed where lawful and technically available

requirements: transparent or open windows that are actual wall openings

infected_progression.early_event: easier/slower infected majority with lower density and simpler coordination
infected_progression.mid_event: mixed runners, armored infected, screamers, regional variants and larger groups
infected_progression.late_event: higher density, faster specialized threats, stronger horde coordination and city pressure

endgame.origin: outer playable perimeter of the U.S. and its jurisdictions
endgame.behavior: progressively contracts inward across the event
endgame.pressure_goal: force remaining survivors toward larger cities over time
endgame.finale: major-city showdown among remaining survivors near the end of Year One
endgame.presentation: original Horizon infected-wall system; no copied Fortnite art/UI/assets

store.weapon_rule: paid weapon variants must be cosmetic or balance-safe sidegrades; meaningful combat power must remain obtainable through free gameplay

rules: each run must make measurable progress when tools permit or record the exact blocker
never provision billable DigitalOcean or GPU resources
never ship ripped or unclear-license assets
never start Year One without the owner start command
never weaken release gates to force publication
keep Horizon commerce and entitlements namespace-separated from B2B
